request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

A wooden cube just floats inside water when a 800 g mass is placed on it. When the mass is removed, the cube is 2 cm above the water level. What is the size of the side of the cube (in cm) ?

result.working:
With the mass on top, the cube is just fully submerged. After the mass is removed, the cube rises by 2 cm, so the volume of water it no longer displaces is a^2 × 2 cm^3.
The buoyant force lost equals the weight of the 800 g mass: a^2 × 2 × 1 g = 800 g.
This gives a^2 = 400 cm^2, so a = 20 cm.
